review: The portfolio guidance needs staged deliverables, a reproducibility handoff, and an honest distinction between course completion and operational experience.
build: Deliver the same capstone in increments: local deterministic slice, persistent authenticated workflow, evaluated retrieval/generation, and a deployed release with recovery evidence. Keep the existing chapter experiments as supporting artifacts.
verify: Provide setup commands, synthetic fixtures, passing checks, an evaluation report, architecture decisions, a failure demo, and a list of implemented versus proposed features. Ask a second person to run it from a clean environment.

capstone.title: Document Assistant Capstone
capstone.description: Build a complete document-question answering application: ingest documents, retrieve evidence, generate cited answers, and recover from failures.

phases.name: Phase 1 — Local deterministic slice
steps: Ingest three synthetic documents with page and revision metadata
Build keyword + vector retrieval with RRF fusion
Generate answers using only supplied evidence with citations
Refuse to answer when evidence is missing
Run assertions: exact answer for known question, refusal for unknown
phases.verify: All assertions pass with synthetic fixtures; no model provider or network needed

phases.name: Phase 2 — Persistent authenticated workflow
steps: Add user identity and ownership checks on documents
Persist ingestion state to SQLite with revision tracking
Add idempotent ingestion with unique operation keys
Log every tool call to an effect ledger
Verify: second person can run from clean environment
phases.verify: Effect ledger contains all tool calls; ownership prevents cross-user access

phases.name: Phase 3 — Evaluated retrieval/generation
steps: Build evaluation dataset with 10 questions and expected answers
Calculate Recall@K, Precision@K, MRR
Run claim-to-evidence check on every generated answer
Produce evaluation report with pass/fail per question
Verify: evaluation report shows which answers lack evidence support
phases.verify: Evaluation report generated; every answer tied to evidence or marked refused

phases.name: Phase 4 — Release with recovery evidence
steps: Write architecture decision records for retriever, generator, and store
Demonstrate failure: corrupted document, failed provider, restart recovery
Show recovery: task resumes after restart with no duplicate effects
Document implemented vs proposed features honestly
Verify: second person reproduces failure and recovery
phases.verify: Failure demo and recovery documented; ADRs committed with code
